summary: The document involves a web-based application for managing staff manual placements, with interactive controls for editing, adding, and deleting details related to staff placements.
purpose: To facilitate the management of staff placements through a web application, allowing users to add, edit, delete, and view details of placements effectively.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Manages staff manual placements through the web interface.

workflows.name: Add Placement
steps: System switches to Add Mode on the detail grid.
User enters placement details and saves.

workflows.name: Edit Placement
steps: System binds data and switches to Edit Mode on the detail grid.

workflows.name: Delete Placement
steps: Upon confirmation, system deletes the placement.

business_rules: User session must be active for data operations.
Screen must be editable for performing add/edit operations.
validations: Prevent insert/update if Page.IsValid is false.
Mandatory dropdowns should have valid values, defaulting to 0 if empty.
conditions: Check if user session is null before proceeding with data operations.
Check if the screen is editable before showing certain controls.
system_behavior: Redirects to the current page after insert/update/delete operations.
Caches user session after data modifications.
dependencies: User session and session hash for security.
Grid control for displaying and managing placement details.
exceptions: Operation is canceled if the user session is null or if Page.IsValid is false.
